page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance configuration allocates 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, backed by 35 MB of L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 48.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include support for AVX and AVX-512F vector extensions, as well as AES hardware acceleration. The instance does not include local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate moderate multi-threaded throughput contrasted with lower single-core execution speed. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 10042.2 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4589.0, placing it in the middle tier for parallelized computation such as software compilation with Clang (8011.0). Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression yields 41.58 GB/sec. Conversely, single-threaded processing reflects the older CPU generation, with a Geekbench single-core score of 905.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.02 GB/sec. Memory subsystem evaluation reveals cached read bandwidth of 491.92 GB/sec, dropping to 56.47 GB/sec on uncached 256 MB reads and 44.31 GB/sec on writes, alongside a PassMark memory score of 1698.88.

From a resource and architectural perspective, ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge provides dedicated CPU allocation suitable for steady, distributed workloads that do not demand cutting-edge single-thread latency. Network-bound performance is constrained by the 2 Gbps baseline, and static web serving throughput measures at 5.98 GB/sec. In-memory data store capabilities remain competitive, with Redis SET operations reaching 8.35 million operations per second. Appropriate deployment targets include general-purpose web backends, CI/CD compilation runners, mid-sized relational or caching databases, and distributed ETL tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 48.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 instance provides a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio without bundled local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external network storage and a 2 Gbps baseline network link. Empirical benchmarks show steady multi-threaded capacity, scoring 10042.2 on PassMark CPU and completing 8.35 million Redis SET operations per second, although single-core throughput reflects older architectural constraints with a 905.0 Geekbench single-core score. With its dedicated vCPU allocation and standard memory density, ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge functions effectively for backend application tiers, software build automation, caching nodes, and general relational database services.
